title: The child and adolescent labour (prohibition and regulation) act, 1986
full_text: Act is under updation and will be uploaded shortly. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198661 Act Number: 61 Enactment Date: 1986-12-23 Act Year: 1986 Short Title: The child and adolescent labour (prohibition and regulation) act, 1986 Long Title: An Act to prohibit the engagement of children in all occupations and to prohibit the engagement of adolescents in hazardous occupations and processes and the matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Labour Skill Employment & Entrepreneurship Department Enforcement Date: 26-05-1993 Type: STATE Location: Rajasthan Notification: 26th May, 1993, vide notification No. S.O. 333(E), dated 26th March, 1993, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii). Ref Act ID: 198661 Schedule 1.
